nav.label: Main menu
language.label: Language
update.ready: A newer Naqsha is ready on this device.
weave.title: Weave
weave.empty: No design yet. Pick a sample in Try it to see the cloth.
tryit.title: Try it
tryit.intro: Choose a sample design to see it woven.
tryit.confirmReplace: Your scanned cards are not saved. Replace them with this sample?
print.scale: Print at 100% scale, do not fit to page.
print.notCut: This is a print for photographing. It is not a cut card and cannot be used on a loom.
profile.name: Card profile:
notice.unverifiedProfile: The values of this card profile are not measured from a real card.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.profile.banner: The card profile could not be used. You can still move between screens.
error.sim.invalid-profile: The card profile is not valid, so the cloth cannot be shown. Check the profile file.
error.sim.invalid-settings: One of the cloth choices is not allowed. The last cloth is still shown. Change the choice and try again.
error.sim.pick-out-of-range: That pick does not exist. Choose a pick between the first and the last.
error.profile.fetch-failed: The card profile file could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
error.profile.not-json: The card profile file is damaged and cannot be read. Replace it with a good copy.
error.profile.invalid-profile: The card profile has wrong or missing values. Correct the profile file.
error.print.invalid-card: This card cannot be printed because the profile or the card holes are not valid. Nothing was downloaded.
error.export.invalid-profile: The card profile is not valid, so no file was made. Check the profile file and try again.
error.export.invalid-card: One or more cards are damaged, so no file was made. Scan those cards again and try again.
error.export.empty-pattern: There is no design to save as a file. Pick a sample in Try it or scan a card first.
error.export.invalid-options: One of the file choices is not allowed, so no file was made. Change the choice and try again.
error.bmpRead.invalid-profile: The card profile is not valid, so the file cannot be read. Check the profile file.
error.bmpRead.invalid-options: One of the file choices is not allowed, so the file cannot be read. Change the choice and try again.
error.bmpRead.not-a-bmp: This is not a BMP file. Choose a file that Naqsha saved.
error.bmpRead.unsupported-bmp: This kind of BMP file is not supported. Choose a file that Naqsha saved.
error.bmpRead.inconsistent-size: The file is damaged or cut short. Choose another copy of the file.
error.bmpRead.width-mismatch: The file does not fit this card profile: it has a different number of ends. Choose the matching card profile or another file.
error.bmpRead.unknown-colour: The file has a colour that is not a lift or no lift. Choose a file that Naqsha saved.
error.archive.not-found: That saved design was not found. It may already be deleted. Check the list.
error.archive.storage-unavailable: Saved designs cannot be reached in this browser right now. Your design is still here. Check that the browser allows site storage and try again.
error.archive.write-failed: The design could not be saved. What you typed is kept. Try again.
error.read.invalid-profile: The card layout file is not valid, so the card cannot be read. See the details below, then choose a correct card layout file.
error.read.invalid-image: This file could not be used as an image. Choose a photo file, such as JPG or PNG, and try again.
error.read.peg-holes-not-found: The two large alignment holes were not found. Place the whole card in the photo on a plain background and try again.
error.read.ambiguous-orientation: The direction of the card could not be decided. Take the photo again with the card flat and lit evenly.
error.read.resolution-too-low: The holes are too small in the photo. Move closer or use a larger photo, then try again.
error.read.card-outside-image: Part of the card is outside the photo. Move the phone back so the whole card fits, then try again.
keep.title: Keep
keep.empty: No design to keep yet. Pick a sample in Try it or scan a card.
keep.export.heading: Make a file for a loom
keep.export.button: Download the file for a loom
keep.export.untested: No loom controller has been tested with this file yet.
keep.save.heading: Save this design
keep.field.name: Name
keep.save.legal: This is a record of the design. It is not legal protection.
keep.list.heading: Saved designs
keep.list.deleteConfirm: Delete this saved design? This cannot be undone.
keep.save.note: Note on this version (optional, up to 200 characters)
keep.version.heading: Versions of {name}, newest first
keep.version.restored: Restored. The next save becomes a new version. Nothing was deleted.
weave.repair.loadFailed: The suggestions could not be loaded. Check your connection and press Suggest repairs again.
repair.heading: Suggested repairs
repair.guesses: These are guesses based on the pattern. Check them against the real card if you can.
repair.gap.damaged: the card could not be read
repair.kind.neighbours: The cards on both sides are the same
repair.evidence.repeat: Cards repeat every {period} picks ({agreeing} of {compared} pairs agree). Taken from pick {picks}.
repair.evidence.mirror: The design is the same read backwards ({agreeing} of {compared} pairs agree). Copied from pick {partner}.
repair.evidence.neighbours: Picks {before} and {after}, on both sides, are the same card.
repair.conflict: These suggestions disagree. Look at both, then accept one or skip them.
repair.draw: Proposed card: {punched} of {total} hook positions punched
repair.undone: The last accepted repair was undone.
repair.none.no-readable-cards: No card could be read, so there is nothing to guess from. No suggestion.
repair.none.too-short: The chain is too short to guess from. No suggestion.
repair.none.no-evidence: There is no repeat, mirror or matching neighbour to guess from. No suggestion.
repair.notApplied.too-few-readable-cards: Too few cards could be read to look for this.
repair.notApplied.no-supporter: No readable card at the matching distance.
repair.notApplied.supporters-tie: The cards at the matching distance disagree equally.
repair.notApplied.centre-pick: This is the middle pick, so it has no mirror partner.
repair.notApplied.partner-out-of-chain: The mirror partner is outside the chain.
repair.notApplied.partner-unreadable: The mirror partner could not be read either.
repair.notApplied.at-chain-edge: This is the first or last pick, so it has only one neighbour.
repair.notApplied.neighbour-unreadable: A neighbouring card could not be read.
repair.notApplied.neighbours-differ: The cards on both sides are different.
repair.failure.invalid-profile: The card profile is not valid, so no suggestions can be made. Load a valid card profile and try again.
repair.failure.not-a-pattern: The design could not be read, so no suggestions can be made. Open the design again.
keep.export.guesses: Some picks are suggested guesses, not read from a card.
tryit.lost: Try a design with lost cards
tryit.lost.hint: Three cards are lost. On Weave, press Suggest repairs.
scan.needsProfile: The card profile is not loaded, so cards cannot be read yet. Check the message at the top of the page.
scan.choose.label: Choose a photo of one card
scan.choose.hint: Photograph one card flat, with the whole card in view, then choose the photo.
scan.camera.hint: Hold the card flat inside the dashed frame, then press Take picture.
scan.camera.denied: The camera is blocked. Allow the camera for this page in your browser, or choose a photo instead.
scan.camera.none: No camera was found on this device. Choose a photo instead.
scan.camera.failed: The camera could not be used. Choose a photo instead.
scan.camera.insecure: The camera needs a secure page (https). Choose a photo instead.
scan.legend.heading: What the marks mean
scan.legend.corrected: Diamond badge: you changed this hook.
scan.legend.tap: Tap a mark to change it. With a keyboard, move with the arrow keys and press Enter or Space to change.
scan.marker.name: Hook row {row}, column {column}: {state}
scan.image.alt: Photo of the card with a mark on every hook position
scan.zoom.heading: Zoom
scan.batch.heading: Cards scanned
scan.batch.empty: No cards yet. Each card you accept is one pick.
scan.batch.removeConfirm: Remove card {number}? This cannot be undone.
scan.done.question: You already have a design. What should the scanned cards do?

codeview.listing.name: Cards as lines of bits
codeview.line.name: Pick {pick}: punched at ends {ends}
codeview.bitline.name: Pick {pick} bits
codeview.breakpoint.name: Breakpoint on pick {pick}
codeview.announce.noBreakpoint: No further breakpoint. Stopped at the last pick.

codeview.jump.label: Go to pick number
codeview.jump.range: Choose a pick number from {first} to {last}.
codeview.cloth.heading: Cloth at the selected pick
codeview.empty: There is no design yet. Read a card on the Scan screen, or choose a sample design on the Weave screen.
codeview.damaged.design: {name} cannot be compared: the card at pick {pick} is damaged. Scan that card again or choose another design.
codeview.diff.heading: Compare two designs
codeview.diff.hint: Added means the card is only in the later design. Removed means the card is only in the earlier design.
codeview.diff.first.label: Earlier design
codeview.diff.second.label: Later design
codeview.diff.noSaved: There is no saved design to compare against. Save a design on the Keep screen first.
codeview.diff.same: The two designs are the same.
codeview.diff.entries.name: Differences, one line for each card
codeview.diff.text.heading: Differences as plain text
codeview.diff.text.name: Plain text of the differences, one line for each card
codeview.diff.copyFailed: The text could not be copied. Select it and copy it yourself.
codeview.refusal.dimension-mismatch: These two designs cannot be compared because their cards are laid out differently: the first has {firstHookRows} hook rows and {firstHookColumns} hook columns, the second has {secondHookRows} hook rows and {secondHookColumns} hook columns. Choose two designs made for the same card profile.
codeview.refusal.profile-mismatch: These two designs were made for different card profiles: {firstProfileName} and {secondProfileName}. Choose two designs that use the same card profile.
codeview.refusal.too-many-picks: These designs are too long to compare. At most {limit} picks can be compared, and these have {firstPicks} and {secondPicks}. Choose shorter designs.
error.codeview.load: Code view could not be loaded. The other screens still work.

keep.list.empty.next: Give the design a name and press Save to keep your first one.
scan.batch.empty.next: Choose a photo of a card to begin.
landing.headline: Read a loom's punch cards. Weave the design again.
landing.steps.name: How it works
weave.purpose: Watch a design being woven, pick by pick, before you thread the loom.
weave.nextStep: Press Play to weave the design, or open Settings to change the colours.
keep.purpose: Save the design on this device, or make a file for an electronic loom.
keep.nextStep: Name the design and press Save, or download the file for a loom.
scan.purpose: Read a card from a photo and add it to your design, one card for each pick.
scan.nextStep: Choose a photo of one card, check the marks, then accept the card.
codeview.purpose: See each card of the design as a line of bits, and compare two designs.
codeview.nextStep: Open a design, then compare it with another, or step through its picks one by one.
